sources.title: The Jewel of Yavin
sources.section: Episode III / Time for a New Plan, printed page 90
verified: Four Shen's Goons approach at Medium personal range
Arrow-7 customized airspeeder with one pilot
Aft-mounted repeating blaster uses personal damage scale

sources.title: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook
sources.section: Chapter VII / The Chase, immediately after difficult maneuvers
verified: Airspeeder chase normally uses planetary range bands
Both pilots make competitive Piloting checks
GM sets difficulty according to terrain
If winner is faster, add range bands equal to verified relative speed difference
Competitive checks occur at beginning of round
GM adjudicates ending at contact or beyond extreme range
Chase maneuver does not override relative position via normal vehicle maneuvers

explicitLimitations: No published Arrow-7 speed/hull/armor values invented
NPC pilot skill/Agility must be entered from a real sheet and explicitly confirmed by GM
No automatic NPC pilot character sheet certification
No automatic encounter completion on chase outcome
No editorial certification of all five adventures or 360 rule consumers
